title: platen-markdown-export frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter keys read by platen-markdown-export. Keys are case-insensitive.

Title.description: Document title. Text after a spaced " — " or ": " becomes the cover subtitle.

Document Info.description: Labelled rows rendered on the cover. Author, Date, Revision and Status are also read by the exporter; any other label is shown as written.

Revisions.description: Revision history table, oldest first. The last row is the current revision.

Revisions Visible.description: How many revision rows the cover shows (0 hides the table). Default 3.

Revision.description: Legacy shorthand, used only when neither Document Info nor Revisions gives a revision.

Version.description: Alias of Revision. Legacy shorthand, used only when neither Document Info nor Revisions gives a revision.

Mode.description: What to export: pdf, html, debug, or a comma-separated combination. Without it the document is not exported.

Export On Save.description: VS Code only: false keeps this document out of export-on-save.

PDF Variant.description: Tags the PDF as a conformance level (PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X), e.g. pdf/a-2b.

Lang.description: Document language (en, nl, de, fr, es); sets generated labels.

Theme.description: Brand package: a theme name (see --list-themes) or a theme directory.

Style.description: Cover style: a named style of the theme (see --list-styles), or a {Name, Color, Image, Position, Overlay} mapping.

Logo.description: Brand mark: a name from the theme's logos map, or a path.

Cover Logo.description: A third-party logo on the cover: a path, or a list of {Path} and {Background} entries.

Cover Page.description: false suppresses the cover but keeps the Style's colours.

Cover Slogan.description: Replaces the theme's cover slogan; false removes it.

Cover Address.description: Replaces the theme's cover address (a string or one line per list entry); false removes it.

Cover Title Color.description: Colour of the cover title, subtitle and rule: hex, rgb()/rgba() or a palette name.

Cover Title Colour.description: Alias of Cover Title Color. Colour of the cover title, subtitle and rule: hex, rgb()/rgba() or a palette name.

Cover Footer Logo.description: The cover's bottom-right mark; false removes it.

Footer Logo.description: The bottom-centre mark on every page; false removes it.

Header.description: Running header text. Defaults to the title.

Footer.description: Running footer text. Defaults to "page N of M".

Running Header.description: The top-left header follows the current section title.

List of Tables.description: Index of captioned tables after the TOC.

List of Figures.description: Index of captioned figures after the TOC.

Code Line Numbers.description: Numbers every line of every fenced code block.

Copy Buttons.description: On by default: a Copy button on every code block in the HTML export.

Watermark.description: Diagonal stamp on every PDF page; true reuses Status. Never shown once Released.

Classification.description: Sensitivity label in the top-right margin.

TOC Depth.description: Deepest heading level listed in the table of contents.

Page Size.description: A3, A4, A5, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, or a "W H" pair. Default A4.

Orientation.description: Page orientation for the whole document.

Variables.description: A mapping substituted into the body as {{Name}}.
